title: Parmigiana di Melanzane
subtitle: Layered aubergine bake with tomato, mozzarella, and Parmesan
excerpt: Slices of aubergine, fried until golden, layered with a simple tomato sauce, mozzarella, and Parmesan, then baked until bubbling and deep amber on top. A southern Italian classic that rewards patience.

recipe.sourceNotes: Parmigiana di melanzane is claimed by both Sicily and Campania, with Naples and Parma also making cases for originating the dish. The name refers to the Parmesan cheese used, not the city of Parma. Despite its association with Italian-American cooking, where aubergine parmesan is a ubiquitous red-sauce restaurant staple, the Italian original is a more restrained dish: no breadcrumb coating on the aubergine, a lighter sauce, and a longer rest before serving. The dish should be made the day before serving when possible: a warm parmigiana is too loose, but after a night in the fridge and a brief reheat it cuts cleanly into firm squares.

content.text: Salting the aubergine is the most important prep step. It draws out moisture so the slices fry rather than steam when they hit the hot oil. Lay the salted slices on a rack or between kitchen paper and leave for at least 30 minutes, then pat very dry. The frying should produce slices that are golden and slightly collapsed, not oily and pale. Drain well on kitchen paper. The dish is better made a day ahead and reheated.

items.preparation: for salting the aubergine, plus more for the sauce

content.text: Lay the aubergine slices on a rack. Salt generously. Leave for 30 minutes. Pat thoroughly dry with kitchen paper.

Make the sauce: heat 2 tablespoons of olive oil in a pan. Add the garlic and cook for 1 minute. Add the tinned tomatoes and season. Simmer for 15 minutes until slightly reduced. Tear in half the basil.

Heat the remaining oil in batches in a wide frying pan over medium-high heat. Fry the aubergine slices in a single layer for 2 to 3 minutes per side until golden. Work in batches. Drain on kitchen paper.

Heat the oven to 180 C / fan 160 C / gas 4. Spread a thin layer of sauce on the base of a baking dish. Layer: aubergine slices, sauce, mozzarella, a scatter of Parmesan, basil. Repeat until all the ingredients are used, finishing with sauce and a generous layer of Parmesan. Bake for 40 to 45 minutes until golden and bubbling. Rest for 20 minutes before serving.
